newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. envoy Ross meets with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy Ross meets with Mubarak.

text.p: U.S. Middle East peace envoy Dennis Ross arrived in Cairo on Saturday and went directly into a meeting with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
Mubarak ended a meeting with Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat just before the arrival of Ross at the presidential palace.
The three men were expected to meet later, presidential palace sources said.

Ross has been holding tlaks in the region for weeks to broker an agreement between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Arafat on the delayed transfer of parts of the West Bank to the Palestinian Authority.
U.S. officials have said Ross would stay in the region to try to clinch the deal.
The U.S. envoy was accused on Friday by a senior official of the Palestinian Authority of abandoning his neutrality and showing bias toward Israel, the Washington Post reported.

The newspaper quoted Hanan Ashrawi as saying Ross's suggestion that Israel and the Palestinians agree to a withdrawal of Israeli troops from the occupied West Bank in 1998 amounted to a compromise that favoured Israel.
